title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.67 (quiet) at 04:00 UTC on 28 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 28 日 04:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.67（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.67 (1M) at 04:00 UTC on 28 September. The 04:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 04:59; hour-start 0.67/1M, hour-end 1.67/2M). Last-180 maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-09-28T04:16:00 UTC; label 2Z). Published-window maximum is 2.00 (first at 2026-09-28T04:16:00 UTC; label 2Z). Window start 2026-09-28T00:00:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 05:00 UTC hour on 28 September is still incomplete (58 samples through 05:57).

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (04:00 UTC on 28 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 04:00 UTC is 0.67/1M and the hour ends 1.67/2M at 04:59. The 05:00 UTC hour on 28 September is incomplete (58 samples through 05:57).
